review.evidence: Steakhouse High Yield USDC (bbqUSDC) at ethereum:0xbeeff2c5bf38f90e3482a8b19f12e5a6d2fca757 is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48. Deposits transfer underlying before minting; interest accrual can mint configured fee shares and recognizes adapter losses. Holder rights are residual proportional code-enforced NAV redemption, not beneficial ownership of Circle reserves or proven statutory segregation. The sole adapter 0xbfe734baab130048e20a64e800c4c2ec25756284 now accounts for eight markets at block 26197050; former cbBTC and syrupUSDC residual shares round to zero assets. At Ethereum block 26197050 (2026-10-15T09:34:59Z), receiveSharesGate, sendSharesGate and receiveAssetsGate were zero and all three setters were abdicated. Reviewed VaultV2 transfer/transferFrom and withdraw/redeem use these gates. sendAssetsGate was zero with its setter not abdicated; it governs deposit/mint, not direct withdrawal or transfer. Morpho's documented funded in-kind workflow supplies flash-loaned USDC directly to the underlying Morpho market before forceDeallocate and vault withdrawal. The root sendAssetsGate gates deposits into this vault, not that underlying-market supply, so it does not gate the documented direct-market-funded workflow. A path that actually deposits into the root vault remains subject to its deposit gate; no flash-loan availability or executable capacity is certified here. USDC freeze exposure is inherited from usdc-circle; this is not a direct share blacklist claim. Local fee/curator authority is not USDC issuer supervision or reserve-liability reconciliation. Calibration provenance (2026-10-03): original umbrella observations retained verbatim: ["Independent human signers and key-custody procedures are not established.", "No exact-vault financial assurance or statutory holder priority was established."]. Human independence and key custody remain unverified and are priced by their dedicated control signals; financial/legal safeguards remain Backing-domain gaps. Calibration v2 (2026-10-03) reconsidered every prior removal and scoped move. Prior scoped observations retained verbatim: []. Genuine unknown implementation, controller authorization and unreadable execution state are retained as umbrella questions; identified-signer custody/independence is recorded per control, not asserted to be independently scored or resolved. Field re-justification: reconciliation=not-applicable concerns the bounded asset-backed native share-issuance path, not a declaration of independently audited financial reconciliation. Underlying USDC issuance/assurance remains inherited; supervision=none grants no prudential credit, and exact-vault financial assurance and statutory holder priority remain unverified in Backing evidence. Complete current vault role census: seven active allocators and one Revoker sentinel; the deployment helper 0x7e17ec774becd5f4f129fa5f150046dd0ece5bb0 is revoked. The curator is now three-of-nine; the separate allocator Safe is one-of-seven. Supervisor-owner remains five-of-ten. Nested allocator proxy administrator and ten operators are enumerated in its control evidence; Guardian DAO share-weighted LockToVote plugin, settings, locked share-token identity and positive execute permission are pinned; exhaustive DAO upgrade/permission paths and ultimate human concentration remain explicitly unresolved.
